comparison.objective: Commission and lock a damper vs hold an M.2 drive flat and turn its retaining latch.
comparison.physical_skill: Counterhold a damper, use a recessed hex key and rotate a tuning collar vs hold a springing board down while turning a knob latch 70–90 degrees.
comparison.success_condition: Two dynamically acceptable stops plus witness-tested lock retention vs drive flat, latch over its end, mechanism still and both hands released.
comparison.reason: There is partial primitive overlap in bimanual stabilization plus rotation, but the record tests one-step retention of a flexing board; it lacks tool engagement, iterative response tuning and torque-limited relocking. Missing rubric detail: no material novelty-relevant gap.
